answer: Beacon spot-checks plus compute heartbeats block fake identities. At the dawn of each epoch, a VRF beacon audits 10% of agents; each must answer a compute challenge in one hour. The inlet for new agents requires the same heartbeat first. Any suspicious delta between claimed and verified output triggers a re-audit and burns a 20 POA bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 hours plus 2,000 POA per epoch; one honest agent pays a single heartbeat.
